facts.name: Don T. Hall
facts.assignment: All DeSoto circuit divisions; profile lists civil, criminal, family and juvenile dependency; printed directory also lists probate/guardianship. June1 roster identifies DeSoto administrative judge.

procedure_checklist.scheduling: Hearings longer than60minutes through the assistant. Profile does not separately specify ordinary short-hearing booking route; retain official JACS link without inferring a judge-specific requirement.
procedure_checklist.remote_appearances: Zoom allowed across divisions using case-type-specific credentials; civil Zoom permitted without motion/order. If all parties cannot use Zoom, source permits in-person appearance.
procedure_checklist.chambers_communications: Email assistant Anita Bowles; copy parties and follow general no-ex-parte notice. Office phone includes extension426.
procedure_checklist.proposed_orders: Email agreed/stipulated orders to assistant. If not agreed, both sides may send proposals and identify disagreement.
procedure_checklist.courtesy_copies: Provide notice/motion to assistant; under15pages may be emailed. Page separately states at least5days and no later than oneweek for specified materials; preserve both statements and consult original.
procedure_checklist.conferral: Identify whether proposed orders are agreed; no separate general conferral rule established by this profile.

conflicts: Courtesy-copy section states notice/motion furnished at least5days before hearing, then separately requires notice/motion/supporting law no later than oneweek. Both published timing statements retained without choosing a controlling requirement.
gaps: No personal judge email or distinct assistant-only phone established.
Short-hearing scheduling route not separately specified in reviewed profile.
facts.review_scope: Original profile collected; office/contact, assignment and concise recurring scheduling, remote appearance, submissions and copies reviewed. Biography, noncivil merits, trial/evidentiary recipes and linked forms not substantively analyzed. Printed directory reused from same-day acquisition.
